# Slide Indicator

Indicate that there is more content available and how many items there are left to cycle or scroll through.<br />
See [Slide Indicator guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/slide-indicator/design)

<Canvas of={SlideindicatorStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Vertical

<Canvas of={SlideindicatorStories.Vertical} />

### Overflow

Keep a limited amount of visible steps.<br />
When more steps are available, use the `ds-slideindicator-step-beforeend` and `ds-slideindicator-step-end` modifiers.

<Canvas of={SlideindicatorStories.Overflow} />
